name: Lying Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Lie sideways on a bench with the low cable behind you, holding the handle.
Keeping a slight elbow bend, raise your arm out to the side.
Lift until your arm is vertical, feeling the side delt contract.
Lower slowly. The cable maintains tension through the full range.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An intermediate cable press-pattern exercise targeting the middle delts. Lying Lateral Raise (Cable) builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
